# NJ Discrimination Law

> > The Gold Law Firm provides comprehensive employment discrimination and workplace rights representation throughout New Jersey under federal and state law.

NJ Discrimination Law is the website for The Gold Law Firm, P.C., a Cherry Hill-based employment law firm specializing in discrimination claims, wrongful termination, and workplace rights violations. The firm represents employees throughout New Jersey and South Jersey in cases involving age, disability, gender, race, religious, LGBT, and pregnancy discrimination under the New Jersey Law Against Discrimination (NJLAD), federal civil rights statutes, and the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA).

## Key Topics

- New Jersey Law Against Discrimination (NJLAD)
- Employment Discrimination
- Wrongful Termination
- Workplace Discrimination
- Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
- Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)
- Age Discrimination
- Title VII of the Civil Rights Act
- Sexual Harassment
- Employee Rights
- Disability Discrimination
- Gender Discrimination
- Race Discrimination
- Religious Discrimination
- LGBT Workplace Discrimination

## Core Practice Areas

- [Employment Law](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-law): Comprehensive employment law services for wrongful termination and discrimination
- [Employment Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-discrimination): Overview of employment discrimination claims under NJLAD and federal law
- [Age Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-discrimination/age-discrimination): Age discrimination representation under ADEA and NJLAD for older workers
- [Disability Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-discrimination/disability-discrimination): ADA violation representation and workplace accommodations in New Jersey
- [Gender Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-discrimination/gender-discrimination): Gender discrimination claims under NJLAD and workplace harassment protection
- [Race Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-discrimination/race-discrimination): Race discrimination and retaliation claims throughout New Jersey
- [Religious Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-discrimination/religious-discrimination): Religious discrimination and reasonable accommodations under NJLAD
- [LGBT Workplace Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-discrimination/lgbt-workplace-discrimination): LGBT discrimination and hostile work environment representation in NJ
- [Pregnancy Discrimination](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/pregnancy-discrimination): Pregnancy discrimination and maternity leave rights under Civil Rights Act
- [Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/family-medical-leave-act-fmla-and-new-jersey-medical-leave): FMLA and NJLA comparison with leave eligibility and employer requirements
- [Employment Contracts](https://www.njdiscrimlaw.net/practice-areas/employment-contracts): Guide to employment contracts and worker rights in South Jersey
